visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair and round glasses wears a white t-shirt featuring a Harry Potter wand graphic. She stands in a bedroom with wooden cabinets and a curtained window in the background, holding a wooden stick and speaking directly to the camera with an expressive face and hand gestures. (2) The camera zooms in slightly as she points to the wand printed on her shirt and appears to slide the wooden stick into the fabric as if it were a holster. Bright graphic overlays of stars appear around the stick during this action. (3) The scene cuts to a medium shot showing an older man in a black Adidas polo shirt and green shorts standing by a bed. He tosses a large duvet into the air. The room has a beige wardrobe and a dreamcatcher hanging on the wall. (4) A series of fast-paced cuts show the woman and the man struggling under a large grey and white duvet cover with the 'Marauder's Map' design. They are partially obscured by the fabric, moving frantically to align the corners. Question mark emojis and 'Variety' text overlays pop up to emphasize the chaotic nature of the task. (5) The woman is seen sitting on the floor, focusing on tying the inner corner of the duvet. The large white comforter is piled up like a ghost over the man. She looks up and smiles tiredly at the camera. (6) The bed is finally made with the themed bedding. The man bows formally to the camera while the woman's hands are seen clapping in the foreground. A yellow 'Success' graphic appears on the screen. (7) The man uses a handheld white fabric steamer to smooth out wrinkles on the duvet cover. The woman stands beside the bed, gesturing toward the finished result. The camera pans across the bed showing the detailed map print and matching pillows.
